senses.gloss: m. (ἡ ἔκκλητος, v. Sm. Ant. s. v. Appellatio) appeal from the decision of a court.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 49:9">Gen. R. s. 49</cite> <he>תולין לו א׳</he> one is permitted to hang up against him i.e. to announce, an appeal—from the dux &c.

<cite ref="Devarim Rabbah 9">Deut. R. s. 9</cite> <he>ליתן לפניו אנקליטין</he> (read <he>ליתלות</he> a. <he>טון …</he>); <cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 8:8:1">Koh. R. to VIII, 8</cite> <he>שיתלה א׳</he> to appeal from his decision. Tanḥ. Thazr. 7 <he>שלא ירננו עליו אונק׳ וכ׳</he> (ed. Bub. 9 <he>יתנו</he>, read <he>יתלו</he>). V. <cite ref="A02298">next w.</cite>
